mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in total nonfarm employment (PAYEMS) indicates expanding labor market conditions that boost corporate earnings and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS increases by at least 0.5% over the prior month, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 5.0%, it signals an overheating labor market that may trigger Federal Reserve tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 5.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The joint increase in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) above their 3-month moving averages signals robust economic growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where both INDPRO and HOUST are above their 3-month moving averages, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates an economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and INDPRO declines, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses equity valuations by increasing discount rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 108.0, it signals a contraction in manufacturing output, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 108.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 2200.0 thousand units, it indicates strong consumer demand for housing, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST > 2200.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in nonfarm employment (PAYEMS) immediately boosts market sentiment, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS increases by at least 0.5% over the prior month, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
